mapper.select: SELECT a.*, b.dept_id FROM student a LEFT JOIN clazz b ON a.clazz_id = b.id LEFT JOIN dept c ON b.dept_id = c.id where a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, b.dorm_building_name, c.id AS studentId, c.student_name FROM ( SELECT dorm.* FROM dorm dorm
and dorm.dorm_building_id = #{dormBuildingId}
and dorm.dorm_no like concat('%', #{dormNo}, '%')
ORDER BY dorm.id DESC LIMIT #{start}, #{pageSize} ) a LEFT JOIN dorm_building b ON a.dorm_building_id = b.id LEFT JOIN student c ON a.id = c.dorm_id ORDER BY a.id DESC
